chunkAria: Chunked prefill size in tokens per engine step
chunkHint: Caps how many prompt tokens a single engine step may ingest. Small chunks keep decode steps short (stable ITL); OFF lets one prefill monopolize the step.
requestsAria: Number of client requests in the workload
maxBatchAria: Maximum number of running sequences in the batch
statusIdle: Run the simulation to watch requests join and leave the running batch
occupancyLabel: Batch occupancy · sequences per engine step
itlSub: each bar = gap between two decoded tokens; spikes are steps stretched by prefill chunks
chunkOffBody: each full prompt prefill monopolizes an engine step — every decoding sequence stalls behind it. Watch the ITL chart spike on prefill steps.
rowTooltipQueue: R{id} queued {time} waiting for a batch slot
truncatedBannerBody: the engine-step safety cap ({steps} steps) was hit with {finished} of {total} requests unfinished — makespan and throughput below cover only the finished subset and are NOT final numbers.
metricQueueWaitSub: avg wait for a batch slot · worst {worst}
selectRequestHint: click a row to inspect its inter-token latency
